records.subject: 米海尔·罗亚·法尔丹姆杨 / 艾蕾西亚 / 法兰西事变
records.summary: Original Ciel source says Roa began manifesting on Elesia's sixteenth birthday, isolation exhausted her mind, and Roa fully occupied the body.
records.effectRaw: 罗亚开始显现; 隔离导致精神耗尽; 罗亚彻底占据身体

records.subject: 米海尔·罗亚·法尔丹姆杨 / 法兰西事变
records.summary: Original Ciel source says Roa used that body to perform a ritual in the town to lure Arcueid, and all town residents were killed; the event is called the France Incident.
records.effectRaw: 罗亚利用这具身体在小镇举行仪式以诱捕爱尔奎特; 全镇居民因此被杀; 法兰西事变

records.subject: 爱尔奎特 / 罗亚 / 艾蕾西亚
records.summary: Original Ciel source says Arcueid found and killed Roa two days later, Elesia died with him, and the Church recovered the body.
records.effectRaw: 爱尔奎特在两天后找到并杀死罗亚; 艾蕾西亚随之死亡; 教会回收遗体
